title: Klarna partners with DNA to bring interest-free, fee-free device payments to customers in Finland | Klarna International
body_markdown:
**Helsinki, November 3, 2026 —** Klarna, the everyday finance network, announced today a new partnership with DNA, one of the leading telecommunications companies in Finland. As of today, DNA customers will be able to pay for smartphones, tablets and other devices through Klarna, with up to three years to pay and no interest or fees.


Under the new DNA Koroton concept, customers apply for credit from Klarna when they buy a device from DNA, meanwhile DNA covers the interest and fees on the customer’s behalf.


“Smartphones, tablets and other devices that are important in everyday life can be significant purchases for many people. We want to continue offering our customers a flexible way to purchase the devices they need without interest or fees,” said Mikko Valtonen, Vice President of DNA’s mobile business.


“A new phone or tablet is often one of the bigger purchases people make, and they value knowing exactly what they will pay and when,” said Oskari Rekola, Head of Finland at Klarna. “We’re proud to partner with DNA to give customers across Finland a simple, transparent way to spread the cost of the devices they rely on every day.”


Klarna will be responsible for providing the credit, invoicing and customer service related to the credit. DNA will continue to be responsible for device sales, deliveries and warranties.


**About Klarna**
Klarna is the everyday finance network. With over 120 million global active Klarna users and 3.8 million transactions per day, Klarna’s AI-powered payments and commerce network is empowering people to pay smarter with a mission to be available everywhere for everything. Consumers can pay with Klarna online, in-store and through Apple Pay & Google Pay. Over 1.2 million retailers trust Klarna’s innovative solutions to drive growth and loyalty, including Apple, Uber, H&M, Saks, Sephora, Macy’s, Ikea, Expedia Group, Nike and Airbnb. Klarna is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: KLAR). For more information, visit


[Klarna.com](http://klarna.com/)


.


**About DNA**


DNA is one of the leading telecommunications companies in Finland. With you, we face forward to a safer and smarter future. We offer connections, services and devices for homes and workplaces, contributing to the digitalisation of society. Already for years, DNA customers have been among the world leaders in mobile data usage. DNA has about 3.7 million subscriptions in its fixed and mobile communications networks. The company has been awarded numerous times as an excellent employer and family-friendly workplace. In 2025, our total revenues were EUR 1,128 million and we employ about 1,600 people around Finland. DNA is a part of Telenor Group, a leading telecommunications company across the Nordics. More information: www.dna.fi, Facebook @
